unlisted_practices: Establish transparent multicenter annotation standards for AI-assisted organ-at-risk contouring.
Report baseline inter-observer variability metrics for manual annotations when evaluating AI contouring.
Avoid circular reference standards, such as consensus contours that incorporate the AI model's own outputs.
Include dosimetric endpoints in addition to geometric similarity metrics (Dice, HD95) when validating AI contouring.
Integrate probabilistic or uncertainty-aware models into AI contouring tools.
Perform failure-mode analysis of AI contouring tools.
Evaluate AI contouring performance within real-world clinical workflows beyond controlled settings.

screen.reason: This is a letter/commentary discussing methodological and clinical considerations (recommendations for validation, uncertainty quantification, workflow assessment) regarding a published deep learning study.
